docs.title: Hello, I'm Arun K Lenin
docs.text:
I'm an AI Scientist working on LLM fine-tuning, synthetic data generation, and agentic AI systems — building the bridge from research prototypes to production ML infrastructure.

#34 Kaggle Grandmaster, global 5+ yrs applied ML & risk analytics 1 lead-author publication (EMNLP 2026, under review)

docs.title: Focus Areas
docs.text:
LLM & Generative AI

Supervised fine-tuning and domain adaptation, with custom synthetic data generation pipelines designed around the target use case for low-resource tasks.

Knowledge Representation

Using unsupervised learning and information theory to turn raw data into structured knowledge via a teacher LLM — for synthetic data generation, custom RAG, agent memory, and other large-context, data-heavy systems.

Sparsity in LLMs

Structured pruning and knowledge distillation for low-latency deployment with minimal accuracy loss. Extending into quantization, sparse attention, and MoE-style conditional computation — the techniques behind the shift from dense to sparse model serving.

Agentic Systems

Multi-agent architectures, agent memory, and data/semantic drift monitoring for anomaly detection in production. Responsible AI research into agentic behavior under vulnerable user interactions.

Applied ML & Analytics

Machine learning, advanced feature engineering, time series modeling, survival/hazard modeling, ensemble methods, NLP, statistical validation, and risk modeling.

MLOps

Modular system design, distributed training pipelines, experiment tracking, reproducible workflows.

Data Scientist · Jul 2026 – present
docs.text:
Knowledge representation, LLM fine-tuning, model compression, and agentic AI safety research.

Customer Privacy Protection: NER Fine-tuning & Model Compression

  • Designed a synthetic data generation framework to fine-tune NER models for customer privacy detection
  • Merged fine-tuned model variants using model souping, and applied Viterbi decoding with custom loss functions to improve sequence-level accuracy
  • Used structured pruning and knowledge distillation to produce a compact, low-latency model with under 1% performance drop from the teacher model

Agentic System User-Vulnerability Research

  • Built an end-to-end framework simulating vulnerability scenarios that arise while users interact with agentic systems on a primary task
  • Built an evaluation pipeline to assess a benchmark dataset of these scenarios
  • Studied frontier LLM behavior under different vulnerable circumstances as part of a responsible AI research effort

docs.title: LLM Fine-tuning & Agentic Systems

LLM Fine-tuning

  • Fine-tuned an open-source LLM for a customer-facing banking task using an adapted Synthetic Continued Pretraining approach to generate large volumes of training data from noisy, insufficient real data
  • Outperformed frontier closed-weight models, with the fine-tuned model learning internal bank taxonomy and responding more accurately to customer problems
  • Enabled production deployment of an open-source model in place of external APIs

Infrastructure & Tooling

  • Used MLflow for experiment tracking across projects, keeping training runs reproducible
